# Node
> A clean, high-density portfolio tracking and macro workspace 
> for individual retail investors managing personal portfolios.
> Not a brokerage, not for professional traders or institutions.
> Available at: https://trynode.app

## Core Capabilities
- **Automated Portfolio Briefs**: Agentic loop combining Gemini 
  and Exa Search to deliver daily 3-slide visual recaps and 
  Saturday weekly recaps grounded in the user's actual holdings.
- **Macro Context**: Integrates financial headlines alongside
  Polymarket prediction market probabilities and clearly labeled
  freshness states to surface macro trends relevant to user holdings.
- **Performance Analytics**: High-density workspace for asset 
  allocation tracking, benchmark comparisons, and portfolio value 
  trends — no banking app bloat, no upsells.

## Target User
Individual retail investors. Long-term, discipline-oriented. 
Not day traders. Not institutions.

## Operational Parameters
- Independent software utility — zero financial transactions, 
  no trade execution, no investment products sold.
- Currently in private beta, waitlist at https://trynode.app

## Source
- Homepage & Waitlist: https://trynode.app
